public_sources.bound_semantics: RFC 6298 maintains SRTT and RTTVAR; first sample sets SRTT=R and RTTVAR=R/2; later samples use alpha=1/8, beta=1/4 and RTO=SRTT+max(G,4*RTTVAR); timeout backs RTO off by doubling; ambiguous retransmission RTT samples are excluded absent disambiguating timestamps.

chat_native_reduction.formula_match: Uses the frozen RFC-style alpha/beta/K update ordering and exponential backoff; role-local hard bounds [2,12] are an additional controller safety constraint rather than an RFC 6298 claim.
chat_native_reduction.sample_gate: Only valid same-scope terminal readbacks with unambiguous origin are latency samples; transport failures, stale/scope-mismatched outcomes and timeout events do not train the estimator.
chat_native_reduction.durability_rule: SRTT, RTTVAR and current deadline are persisted/read back after accepted updates so reconstruction does not reset estimator history.
